import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

COLOR_OURS = '#0072B2'
COLOR_TEAL = '#E69F00'
COLOR_DENSE = '#999999'

# Data
kl_sparsity = [28.5, 50.0, 69.9]
kl_ppl = [8.76, 12.00, 17.91]

teal_sparsity = [50.0]
teal_ppl = [23.31]

dense_ppl = 6.12

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# Dense baseline
ax.axhline(y=dense_ppl, color=COLOR_DENSE, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
ax.text(72, dense_ppl + 0.4, f'Dense ({dense_ppl})', color=COLOR_DENSE,
        fontsize=9, ha='right', va='bottom')

# KL Predictor line
ax.plot(kl_sparsity, kl_ppl, 'o-', color=COLOR_OURS, markersize=7,
        label='KL Predictor (Ours)', zorder=3)

# TEAL baseline point
ax.plot(teal_sparsity, teal_ppl, '^', color=COLOR_TEAL, markersize=8,
        markeredgewidth=1.5, label='TEAL (training-free)', zorder=3)

# Annotate KL PPL values
offsets = [(0, -1.5), (0, -1.5), (0, 1.0)]
for (x, y), (dx, dy) in zip(zip(kl_sparsity, kl_ppl), offsets):
    ax.annotate(f'{y:.2f}', (x, y), textcoords='offset points',
                xytext=(dx, dy * 8), fontsize=9, color=COLOR_OURS,
                ha='center', va='top' if dy < 0 else 'bottom')

# Annotate TEAL PPL value
ax.annotate(f'{teal_ppl[0]:.2f}', (teal_sparsity[0], teal_ppl[0]),
            textcoords='offset points', xytext=(8, 2), fontsize=9,
            color=COLOR_TEAL, ha='left', va='bottom')

# Delta annotation at 50%
delta = teal_ppl[0] - 12.00
mid_y = (12.00 + teal_ppl[0]) / 2
ax.annotate('', xy=(51.5, 12.00), xytext=(51.5, teal_ppl[0]),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.2))
ax.text(53, mid_y, f'$\\Delta$={delta:.2f}', fontsize=9, color='#555555',
        va='center', ha='left')

# Axes
ax.set_xlabel('Achieved Model-Level Sparsity (%)')
ax.set_ylabel('WikiText-2 Perplexity')
ax.set_xlim(20, 75)
ax.set_ylim(4, 28)

# Grid
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=0)

# Legend
ax.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none')

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_14/projects/distill_sparse_swiglu/figures/paper'
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_sparsity_sweep.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_sparsity_sweep.png')
plt.close()
print('Done')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

COLOR_OURS = '#0072B2'
COLOR_TEAL = '#E69F00'
COLOR_DENSE = '#999999'

# Data
kl_sparsity = [28.5, 50.0, 69.9]
kl_ppl = [8.98, 12.00, 17.91]

teal_sparsity = [50.0, 69.9]
teal_ppl = [23.31, 17.91]

dense_ppl = 6.12

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# Dense baseline
ax.axhline(y=dense_ppl, color=COLOR_DENSE, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=1)
ax.text(72, dense_ppl + 0.4, f'Dense ({dense_ppl})', color=COLOR_DENSE,
        fontsize=9, ha='right', va='bottom')

# KL Predictor line
ax.plot(kl_sparsity, kl_ppl, 'o-', color=COLOR_OURS, markersize=7,
        label='KL Predictor (Ours)', zorder=3)

# TEAL baseline point
ax.plot(teal_sparsity, teal_ppl, '^', color=COLOR_TEAL, markersize=8,
        markeredgewidth=1.5, label='TEAL (training-free)', zorder=3)

# Annotate KL PPL values
offsets = [(0, -1.5), (0, -1.5), (0, 1.0)]
for (x, y), (dx, dy) in zip(zip(kl_sparsity, kl_ppl), offsets):
    ax.annotate(f'{y:.2f}', (x, y), textcoords='offset points',
                xytext=(dx, dy * 8), fontsize=9, color=COLOR_OURS,
                ha='center', va='top' if dy < 0 else 'bottom')

# Annotate TEAL PPL value
ax.annotate(f'{teal_ppl[0]:.2f}', (teal_sparsity[0], teal_ppl[0]),
            textcoords='offset points', xytext=(8, 2), fontsize=9,
            color=COLOR_TEAL, ha='left', va='bottom')

# Delta annotation at 50%
delta = teal_ppl[0] - 12.00
mid_y = (12.00 + teal_ppl[0]) / 2
ax.annotate('', xy=(51.5, 12.00), xytext=(51.5, teal_ppl[0]),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#555555', lw=1.2))
ax.text(53, mid_y, f'$\\Delta$={delta:.2f}', fontsize=9, color='#555555',
        va='center', ha='left')

# Axes
ax.set_xlabel('Achieved Model-Level Sparsity (%)')
ax.set_ylabel('WikiText-2 Perplexity')
ax.set_xlim(20, 75)
ax.set_ylim(4, 28)

# Grid
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=0)

# Legend
ax.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='none')

plt.tight_layout()

outdir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_14/projects/distill_sparse_swiglu/figures/paper'
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_sparsity_sweep.pdf')
plt.savefig(f'{outdir}/fig2_sparsity_sweep.png')
plt.close()
print('Done')
